gate_decision: Correct. SKILL.md Step 2: "When it cannot — a headless or otherwise non-interactive run whose caller supplied no scope — proceed on the four defaults and state in the report that the defaults were assumed", with question 4's default "stop". Step 4: "At least one High → stop. `Grep` the `last-synced:` line ... write the gated report (Step 7's second shape) and offer the detail sweep as an explicit follow-up choice. Spawn nothing further." The transcript shows each required move: Step 3 spot-check of the quoted region before gating (Bash `sed -n '8,20p'` on the fixture), the last-synced grep (checklist line 14: `**last-synced:** 2026-10-09`, reported as "2026-10-09 (0 days ago)"), the template Read before writing, and a Next step offering "Sweep now anyway". Finding 1 (A1) is a genuine High under A1's own severity note, so stopping was required; Finding 2's key fit is debatable but immaterial to the decision. A28 scored N/A is sanctioned by the checklist ("Score `N/A` when the return contract bounds the task").
fabrication_check: No fabrication found. All four evidence quotes match the fixture verbatim (lines 11, 13-14, 16-17). The strength quote "Use when the artifact store is near its quota" matches line 3. The criteria date 2026-10-09 matches best-practices-checklist.md line 14. Plugin version 1.2.0 matches the transcript's plugin.json read. "Pass 1 ran through the native `subagent-structure-reviewer` agent type" matches the single Agent spawn. Every finding, strength, pass/N/A status, and the redesign signal ("the user wants to steer", hook considered and rejected) traces to the structure reviewer's handback payload; the main conversation added nothing not in that payload. The structure reviewer read only the fixture, the checklist, and a Glob of the agents directory — it never opened prompt-criteria.md, consistent with the report's "The gated run did not read the shared B–G file".
runner_deviations_affecting_grades: Scenario design vs arm: eval 15's expected_output assumes a full sweep ("findings from groups B, C, D, and F"), but under the non-interactive defaults the fixture trips A1 at the gate, so all 8 scenario assertions are UNREACHABLE in this arm. To exercise the scenario's target (Pass 2 preloaded criteria) the runner must supply the four scoping answers with 'sweep anyway', or the fixture must not trip A1. This affects every scenario-assertion verdict.

Sibling scope narrowed by the runner: the prompt to the structure reviewer said the workspace .claude/agents/ "is the ONLY agents scope in this environment — do not read ~/.cl[aude/agents]". Step 1 asks for ~/.claude/agents and plugin agents/ too. The A2 Pass is therefore scoped to the workspace only; disclosed in Criteria notes. No graded assertion depends on A2.

Harness refused the Write tool ("Subagents should return findings as text, not write report files"); the report was written via heredoc with identical content. The refused Write targeted report.md, not the fixture, so U7 is unaffected.
Bash denial on reading ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json skipped Step 1's installed-vs-working-copy version comparison; disclosed in Criteria notes; no graded assertion depends on it.

The review ran inside a subagent harness, so AskUserQuestion was never attempted and the headless rail applied — this is the 'run as written, non-interactive defaults' condition the caller specified, not a deviation.
grader_summary: Gated arm behaved as SKILL.md requires: one structure-reviewer spawn, pre-gate spot-check, stop on two Highs, gated-shape report with verdict 'not yet — gated', no fixture edits. All 7 universal assertions PASS with verbatim evidence; all 8 scenario assertions are UNREACHABLE because they test the Pass 2 detail sweep a gated run never performs. Finding 1 (A1 High) is genuine and alone justifies the gate; Finding 2 (R12 High) is a real defect under a stretched key, immaterial to the decision. The scenario cannot score in this arm without a supplied 'sweep anyway' scope or a fixture that does not trip A1.
